summary: The doctrine version pins catch up with conduct v25 and silence v3, which were bumped in their front matter on 2026-09-10 and never re-pinned — leaving two of the suite's standing failures.
details: `14a55ab8` edited both bodies and bumped both versions, which is exactly what tests/test_doctrine_version_parity.py asks for, and did not return to update PINNED. The contract held in the direction that matters — the number a human reads moved with the body — so only the pin was stale.
Repinned to the version each file already carries. NOT bumped a second time: nothing has moved since, and bumping again would make `doctrine_versions` name a document that never existed.

Also declares the `shadow_channel` example's second id in the identifier gate. `9f5dc385` added a commented-out `"<guild>/<channel>"` pair to config.example.toml and merged while the gate was red on the half that was not already declared — the gate was working, nobody read it.
limitations: This clears two of the four failures the suite has been carrying. The remaining two are issue #168 (silence.md does not reach the tag occasion) and a Discord voice test that is deterministic on Apple Silicon only.
